lines: Gogogogogogogogo......!!
The dimensional “rift” opened.
Through it, something horrifying to even look at was gradually emerging into this world.
A rotten breeze blew through from the “other side”.
Bathed in that, the vast hall transformed into the landscape of a completely different planet.
The hooded sorcerers lost their forms, metamorphosing into horrifying creatures of another world.
――This, in other words, was a view of the devastation that the dimensional invader would wreak.
Sorcerer
『KUHAHAHAHA!! At last, I have achieved my heart's desire!!』
The ringleader sorcerer laughed loudly beneath the jet-black dimensional rent that had opened up.
Thinking back, the impetus for this was that old black magic tome, which he had acquired on a whim.
The man was originally an ordinary magus.
A low-level magus who had no particular outstanding talents, and only performed work for hire.
However, those days were to change, thanks to the magic book that he had unexpectedly procured.
......The voice of “something” had begun to speak to him in his dreams.
Secrets of this world, long-lost ancient magics, all manner of forbidden rituals......
The man had become obsessed with seeking new powers, and eventually reached the point of summoning a powerful god from the abyss of the Otherworld, like so.
In other words, this was his heart's desire.
Sorcerer
Sorcerer
（But...... was this really what I wished for......?）
A cold wind suddenly blew across the man's heart.
He couldn't remember at all. Why had he harboured a grandiose desire like this......?
『HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!』
Sorcerer
『What the?!!』
The sorcerer raised his face.
In a corner of the vast room, there was a woman pointing her cyborg arms at the dimensional rift.
Clone Asagi
「“Nemesis Gravity”, maximum output―――」
The latest and most powerful cyborg technology that Secret Service “G” had produced, the “Nemesis” gravitational control unit.
She slammed the powerful gravitational field that it had generated against the dimensional rift, trying to block the invader's path and drive it back.
What was more――
Aki
「All right, monsters, come at me from anywhere you want!!」
Monsters
「GYAAAAAAAAA?!!!」
One after another, Fuuma Aki cut down the sorcerers and their followers, who had transformed into monsters.
It was a bizarre scene.
Even though they only sustained slight scratches, the monsters that Aki slashed collapsed, spurting huge amounts of fresh blood.
『HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!』
The intruder squirmed in apparent displeasure.
Something tiny was putting up an invisible barrier to block its path.
It slowly extended its ugly and monstrous tentacles to exact retribution for that act of folly.
Nasara
「......＠×％■, eliminate...... 『Transforming Predator』.」
In order to block them, Nasara deployed her own tentacles.
Guchaguchagiruboriguchuguchuguchaguchugorigori gujujurujurururu――
They intertwined with the invader's, and a hellish scene unfolded in which they preyed upon and devoured one another.
Sorcerer
『Wh-What are you people?! My god!! My ambition――』
Miriam
「.........Rather than that, shouldn't you worry more about yourself?」
Sorcerer
『?!! Gyaaaaaaaah!!!!』
Miriam was behind the sorcerer.
She had taken advantage of the followers and monsters scattering in the confusion to sneak up and grab firm hold of his head.
Miriam
「I can't take on a monster like that directly.」
Miriam
「So, I'm going to have you show me inside your head what kind of spell you've put together.」
Sorcerer
『Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhh?!!!』
The sorcerer screamed from the agony of having his mind forcibly “probed”.
――This was the strategy for the four of them.
It was absolutely impossible to inflict a fatal wound on the dimensional invader, which was on a different scale of existence.
In which case, they would seal the “rift” which connected this side to that, and drive it back where it came from――
For that purpose, they had divided their efforts.
First, Clone Asagi and the other two would block the invader's path, and in the meantime, the witch, Miriam, would search for a means to close the rift.
Clone Asagi
（――But that won't last long!!!）
Clone Asagi
Clone Asagi groaned painfully, as she deployed her super-heavy space.
Her supposedly-sturdy cyborg arms were creaking.
Even though she was blocking it with so much power, there was no sign whatsoever of its invasion diminishing.
Aki
「O-Oi?!! Are you done yet, Miriam-chan? The Detective's arms are almost at their limit!!」
Aki shouted, as she slew the monsters.
Miriam
「H-Hold on a little longer! This bonehead mage's had the audacity to put together one sophisticated spell!」
Miriam
「To stop this, let's see... It'll be at least 20 more minutes......」
Clone Asagi
「―――That's impossible!! Do something in 5!!!!」
Miriam
「Whaaaaaaat～～～～～?!!!」
Miriam wracked her brain.
Miriam
「Ahhh, what do I do, what do I do?!! Shiiit! If this were the super-great me from before I had my magic power taken away......!!」
Using the knowledge that she had gleaned from the ringleader's mind as a stepping stone, she considered all sorts of spells.
However, their base output wouldn't be enough.
Miriam
「It's a solidly-constructed spell, using a ridiculously huge amount for its “offering”. If we could use something as a catalyst too――」
Kuro reacted to that tense muttering.
Kuro
「Pih! Pipiiih～!」
Miriam
「What?! There is a catalyst?!!」
Miriam
「Ohhh～, nice one, Kuro!! If there's this much junk, that'll be plenty. Do it at once, you guys!!」
Shiro & Kuro
「Kyu!」 「Pipiiih～!!」
What Kuro had told Miriam about was the “laboratory” that it had been put in when it was caught.
Culture tanks with strange creatures in them crowded the place side-by-side. If they used these as an “offering”, it would double the spell's output.
Sorcerer
『Hiiiiiih......?! My research?! Stop, please stooooop!!!』
Smashing sounds, from Shiro and Kuro swooping around and destroying the culture tanks.
Hearing that, the ringleader, who was on the verge of death, staggered into the lab, but――
Miriam
「Fuhahahaha, it's your just desserts, fool!! This is what happens when you seek power that's out of your league!!」
Miriam
「――All right, we're all set, Detective!! I'll reverse the spell!!」
Gogogogogogogogo......!!
『HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!』
Having sensed an anomaly, the invader roared.
In a sudden turnaround, the dimensional fissure shifted to contracting――
To try and counter that, it extended its powerful tentacles to the woman who was deploying the invisible barrier.
Clone Asagi
Gushaaa!!!!
However, Nasara had stood in the way, in the face of that sinister bloodthirst.
Nasara
「.........Eliminate, ＠×％■...... Nasara, fights together......」
Clone Asagi
「Nasara!!!」
She had taken the invader's tentacles herself, to protect Clone Asagi.
The tentacles pierced deep into her torso――but Nasara didn't alter her expression one bit.
Nasara
「＠×％■, feeling pressured...... A little more...... victory......」
Clone Asagi
「Yeah, I get it...... Aki!! I'll push it in!」
Aki
「Roger, Detective!!!」
Aki yelled, having wiped out the monsters.
The eye on one side of her changed colour, and glowed mysteriously.
Aki
「You rotten interdimensional bastard! You picked on Nasara-chan, didn't you......?」
Aki
「I'm gonna teach you what true pain is!!!」
Evil Eye: “Death Rending”.
Fuuma Aki's Evil Eye ability, which inflicted damage not to the body, but to the mind, and turned even the slightest scratch into a fatal wound.
Even if this was a mighty dimensional invader that was on a different scale of existence, as long as it had a will and emotions, then Death Rending's blades would be sure to penetrate deeply―――
Aki
「HAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!」
One strike.
Just one slight, little cut had run across the gigantic invader's eyeball, but――
『HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA??!!!!』
That wound spread in an instant, and dark blood sprayed from the dimensional rift.
The invader staggered far back.
Of course, for the massive invader, that couldn't possibly be a fatal wound.
It was only enough damage for it to recoil for a moment.
But right now, that was enough.
『HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA??!!!!』
Gogogogogogogogogo......!!
With a roar, the spacial fissure closed.
The invader plummeted into the dimensional abyss, leaving a cry of unfathomable madness behind it――
Half a day had passed.
After Clone Asagi and the others had withdrawn, leaving it to the local bosses to deal with the building.
All of a sudden, the figure of a person appeared in the deserted hall.
Tsukishima
「Heeheehee, that was sure something. To think that four people could do something about that terrible monster......」
Tsukishima
「That's “Her” clone for you. My, I'm most impressed......」
It was the information dealer named Tsukishima, who had provided Clone Asagi and the others with information on the fanatics.
He cautiously and stealthily approached the altar, and held his hand over some small debris that had turned to cinders there.
Tsukishima
He chanted a strange incantation.
And when he did, the ashes bubbled, liquefying and taking some kind of form.
Tsukishima
「Heeheehee. All right, it's done......」
What was there was an old magic book.
The black magic tome, which had been the cause of the ringleader being seduced by Otherworldly power, had reconstituted itself, clad in jet-black miasma.
Tsukishima
「It looks like you've absorbed plenty of power from the “other side” for me, eh? Splendid, splendid. Heehee, heeheehee!」
Having taken the black magic tome in hand, Tsukishima's form wavered and transformed――
Fürst
「Hohohoho, I'm most looking forward to finding out what kind of calamity will unfold.」
Nomad Senior Executive Fürst laughed creepily, and disappeared into the darkness.
A few days later――
Clone Asagi
「Understood. I'll pay the price you're asking. Honestly, you're always so greedy......」
『Not at all. Where money is concerned, I have more than I could ever need. But it's not much fun if I mend them for free, is it?』
『Now, go work hard and make money for me, Detective-san. Kuku――』
Clone Asagi hung up with a sour expression.
The person she had just been talking to was the demonologist woman responsible for the maintenance of her cyborg arms and legs.
She was amazingly skilled, but owing to her extremely eccentric personality, Clone Asagi was always being manipulated.
And even on this occasion, when she asked for maintenance on her android arms, which had worn out in the battle with the invader, an unexpectedly high amount of money had been demanded.
Clone Asagi
「Well, I can't complain, can I? I do have a debt of gratitude to her――」
Clone Asagi collected herself, and began walking.
Her detective work itself was something that she had started doing to pay for maintenance in the first place.
She would manage to perform her work somehow, just like always.
Clone Asagi
When she got in front of her office, rowdy voices were audible from inside.
Clone Asagi
They were all voices that she knew well.
While breathing a sigh, Clone Asagi opened the door.
Miriam
「Fuhahahaha!! The guys at Nomad made fun of my height, so I ran away from home!!」
Shiro & Kuro
「Kyu!」 「Pipiiih!!」
Aki
「Guuh, calm down, me...... What do I do about hospitality......?! Cake?! Or sweets?!」
Nasara
「Very interesting......」
Inside the office, the usual crowd was making a racket.
Aki, who had settled into her office like there was nothing wrong with doing so.
Miriam, who seemed to have taken a liking to the place.
And Nasara, who had also started to show up frequently for whatever reason.
Clone Asagi
「This is a place of business, you guys......」
Clone Asagi breathed a sigh, thinking, “Good grief.”
It looked like her detective business would still have a lot more challenges to come.
